newsitem.title: USA: Wisconsin Energy to buy ESELCO.
newsitem.headline: Wisconsin Energy to buy ESELCO.

text.p: Wisconsin Energy Corp. said Tuesday that it signed a letter of intent to acquire ESELCO Inc. in a stock transaction valued at about $71 million.
ESELCO, parent of Edison Sault Electric Co., is an electric utility serving about 22,000 residential, commercial and industrial customers in Michigan's eastern Upper Peninsula.
The announcement said all outstanding shares of ESELCO would be converted into Wisconsin Energy common stock based on a value of $44.50 for each share of ESELCO.
ESELCO's stock jumped $6.50 to $37 in early trading on the Nasdaq market. Wisconsin Energy was unchanged at $24.50 on the New York Stock Exchange.
The proposed transaction is structured as a tax-free reorganization, Milwaukee-based Wisconsin Energy said in a statement.
Completion of the transaction requires negotiation of a definitive agreement, approval by directors of both companies and shareholders of ESELCO and regulatory approvals.

Wisconsin Energy, a holding company with subsidiaries in utility and non-utility businesses, including Wisconsin Electric, provides electricity, natural gas and steam service to about 1.2 million customers.
